summary: Frontend-only E2E of new LUMIÈRE features in Cut Pro Editor (RESULT player after Apply, Text-on-video overlay, transition-speed, music-volume with conditional rendering) and Social Studio new brand styles 'Póster / Trend' + 'Emblema / Sello'. All primary flows PASS. Regression: applying still creates a new version (V1→V10 accumulated) and returning via 'Edit again' restores the muted source preview.

minor.issue: One transient 500 observed at 21:51 UTC with FileNotFoundError: 'ffprobe' from ffmpeg_worker.probe(). Not reproducible on the very next attempt (curl + UI both succeeded and produced V9/V10). PATH of the uvicorn process includes /usr/bin (where ffprobe lives), so this was likely a race right after supervisor reload/hot-reload. Recommend adding a stderr guard (returncode / FileNotFoundError catch) so the API returns a clean error instead of 500 if the binary is momentarily unavailable.

rca of the issue: Transient 500 on /api/cuts/{id}/pro-edit: FileNotFoundError('ffprobe') from subprocess.run inside ffmpeg_worker.probe(). Repro: first UI Apply hit right after previous render churn. Mitigation: the very next curl and UI Apply both succeeded (V9, V10 produced with dissolve+music+text overlay). Long-term fix: wrap subprocess calls with try/except FileNotFoundError → return structured error; add a startup healthcheck for ffprobe/ffmpeg binaries.
